title: Buzz and Bloom ABC
hook: Color follows where the little wings lead!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: whimsical 3D flower-and-bug storybook, pastel petals, fresh greens, cute but recognizable insects, crisp silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child tracking a tiny pollinator-scale route through petals, leaves, scent and soil
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: lift into a short fluttering refrain that reconnects wing movement with flower color
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written pollinator-scale close-ups; alternate color, scent, texture, crawling and flying motion, allowing non-flower objects to remain practical scene anchors
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: flutter/flower cue -> recall beat -> target -> one compact object-specific motion
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn the garden into a small pollinator journey: wing, scent, color and petal shape guide the ear from one close-up to the next.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows a bee-sized path through flowers and leafy corners; flutter verbs, color words, scent images and brief hovering pauses replace generic flower praise.
semanticArc: a first wing enters the garden
the route moves through soil and leafy shelter
color and scent become denser among flowers
the final blooms settle after the small wings pass
forbiddenGenericLanguage: buzz and bloom come sing with me
